fusions.name: Unpicked Seam
fusions.desc: A quick cut along the seams that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cape Over the Eyes
fusions.desc: Sweeps the cloak across and cuts behind it: it deals 12 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrapped Forearm
fusions.desc: Wraps the cloak around your off arm to parry with: it absorbs the next 16 damage, up to 3 blows, and holds for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tasselled Knot
fusions.desc: Conjures a silk sword-knot: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more damage, your attack speed rises by 4%, and each kill returns 3 health.
